# International Cryptoasset Analytics Workshop (CAAW)

> CAAW is an annual academic workshop for empirical and data-driven research on cryptoassets, blockchains and decentralized finance (DeFi). It is co-located with a major conference. Since 2025 that conference is Financial Cryptography and Data Security (FC). The 2022–2024 editions were co-located with The ACM Web Conference. Accepted papers appear in the FC workshops proceedings in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS).

## Current edition: CAAW 2027

- [CAAW 2027](https://caaw.io/2027/): the 6th edition, February 12, 2027, at the Accra Beach Hotel & Spa, Barbados. It is co-located with Financial Cryptography and Data Security 2027 ([FC 2027](https://fc27.ifca.ai/)).
- Submission deadline: November 20, 2026, 11:59 PM Anywhere on Earth (firm)
- Acceptance notification: December 18, 2026
- Camera-ready version: January 5, 2027
- Submissions: [EasyChair](https://easychair.org/conferences/?conf=caaw27). Review is double-blind. Full papers have at most 15 pages, short papers at most 8 pages and posters at most 3 pages, including references and appendices, in Springer LNCS format.
- Contact: caaw27@easychair.org
- Organizers: Bernhard Haslhofer (Complexity Science Hub Vienna), Friedhelm Victor (TRM Labs), Jiahua Xu (UCL Centre for Blockchain Technologies), Aviv Yaish (Princeton University), Co-Pierre Georg (Frankfurt School of Finance & Management)

## Topics

- Empirical studies of cryptoassets, blockchains, DeFi, cross-chain interactions and Layer-2 systems
- Analytics methods and tools, such as address clustering, anonymization and identification, dataset extraction and labeling, and smart contract analysis
- Case studies of markets and exchanges, security breaches and fraud
- Cryptoassets and the Web
- Reusable datasets and benchmarks
- Cross-cutting issues, including economic, legal and ethical aspects

## Previous editions

- [CAAW 2026](https://caaw.io/2026/): 5th edition, March 6, 2026, St. Kitts, co-located with FC 2026
- [CAAW 2025](https://caaw.io/2025/): 4th edition, April 18, 2025, Miyakojima, Japan, co-located with FC 2025
- [CAAW 2024](https://caaw.io/2024/): 3rd edition, May 14, 2024, Singapore, co-located with The ACM Web Conference 2024
- [CAAW 2023](https://caaw.io/2023/): 2nd edition, May 1, 2023, Austin, Texas, USA, co-located with The ACM Web Conference 2023
- [CAAW 2022](https://caaw.io/2022/): 1st edition, April 25, 2022, online (hosted by Lyon, France), co-located with The ACM Web Conference 2022
